bloomweaver_fallen_1.text: Up, dear. The kelp has you.

bloomweaver_krogg_1.text: Poor lamb. Rusted to his post.

bloomweaver_lamp_1.text: There. That will keep the damp off.

bloomweaver_late_1.text: She is coming home, the sea. Quick now.

bloomweaver_pull_1.text: The sea takes. It also gives back, if you ask nicely.

bloomweaver_pull_2.text: Kelp does not hurry. Neither do I.

bloomweaver_sulmar_1.text: He never could leave that rope alone.

bloomweaver_velisse_1.text: A ward full of crabs. She would be mortified.

duelist_krogg_1.text: Big keys. Must be a big lock.

duelist_late_1.text: I cannot swim in these boots.

duelist_pull_1.text: I am only here for the candlesticks.

duelist_pull_2.text: Nobody mentioned they would still be home.

duelist_sulmar_1.text: That bell would fetch a fortune. I am only saying.

ending_in_time.text: You climb the sea stair with dry boots. Below you, for the first time in a hundred years, the abbey sleeps.

ending_late.text: The tide caught you on the stair and you came home soaked to the collar. But the lamps hold, and the abbey sleeps.

mender_fallen_1.text: No, no, no. Up you get!

mender_krogg_1.text: Brother Krogg. We have come to relieve you.

mender_lamp_1.text: One more light against the dark.

mender_late_1.text: The tide is turning. I can hear it.

mender_pull_2.text: Hold still. This only stings if you argue.

mender_pull_3.text: They were brothers once. Be gentle.

mender_sulmar_1.text: Father Abbot. You can stop ringing now.

mender_velisse_1.text: She is still nursing them. Oh, Sister.

opening_1.text: A hundred years ago, Abbot Sulmar rang the great bell against the storm. The sea answered.

opening_2.text: Tonight the tide draws back for fourteen minutes.

opening_3.text: Three lamps wait in the dark. Light them, and the abbey may finally sleep.

pyromancer_fallen_1.text: Was that my fault? That felt like my fault.

pyromancer_krogg_1.text: Excuse us! We have an appointment?

pyromancer_late_1.text: Wet wicks. This is my nightmare.

pyromancer_pull_1.text: Sorry. Sorry! That one got away from me.

pyromancer_pull_2.text: Six generations of candles and nobody mentioned this.

pyromancer_pull_3.text: Is it meant to be this damp?

pyromancer_velisse_1.text: I am sure she is a very good nurse.

warden_fallen_1.text: Hold the line. We will fetch them after.

warden_krogg_1.text: A gatekeeper. I know the type.

warden_lamp_1.text: Now that is a proper harbour light.

warden_late_1.text: Water is coming in. Pick up your feet.

warden_pull_1.text: In, all of you. The sea takes the doorways first.

warden_pull_2.text: Behind me. All of you. Yes, you too.

warden_pull_3.text: Steady. I have seen worse weather.

warden_sulmar_1.text: When that bell swings, find a pillar.

warden_velisse_1.text: Mind the little ones. They nip.
